description: Check whether a set of connection settings actually works, before saving them. Pass an existing dataSourceId to retest a saved connection, or a type and config to test new settings.

config.description: Connection settings for this connector type, for example { host, port, database, username, password, ssl } for postgres. Credentials are stored encrypted at rest and are never returned by read tools.

dataSourceId.description: Test a saved data source. Omit to test new settings.

type.description: Connector type. Call list_supported_data_connectors for the settings each one expects.

name: test_data_source_connection
title: Test a data source connection
